title: Scales and Slime Rhyme
hook: Texture is biology, not a joke.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: friendly 3D scales-and-slime storybook, glossy but clean textures, non-scary creatures, high-contrast foregrounds

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child comparing skin physiology respectfully
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written skin/moisture facts; no touching wildlife
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: surface cue -> recall beat -> target -> visual texture gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a pizzicato raindrop figure followed by a tiny woodblock footstep.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a pizzicato raindrop figure followed by a tiny woodblock footstep
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Scales and Slime Rhyme a skin-and-moisture lesson: reptile keratin scales, amphibian permeable skin, mucus, aquatic gills and shells are compared without using 'slimy' as an insult.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child notices surface texture and moisture as physiology, not gross-out comedy.
